title: Order management – requirements (demonstration)
summary: Requirements derived from the demonstration order-management BRD.

requirements.title: Place order
requirements.statement: A registered customer must be able to place an order for one or more products from their cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cart with at least one line, when the customer checks out, then an order with status PLACED is created

requirements.title: Order confirmation
requirements.statement: The customer must receive a confirmation containing the order number when an order is placed.
acceptance_criteria: The response to a successful order placement contains the order number

requirements.title: Cancel order
requirements.statement: A customer must be able to cancel an order that has not been shipped.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelling an order in status PLACED or PAID sets it to CANCELLED
Cancelling an order in status SHIPPED is rejected

requirements.title: View order status
requirements.statement: A customer must be able to see the current status of each of their orders.
acceptance_criteria: The order list shows each order with one of PLACED, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED

requirements.title: Record shipment
requirements.statement: Warehouse staff must be able to set an order to shipped.
acceptance_criteria: After warehouse staff record the shipment the customer sees status SHIPPED

requirements.title: Take payment
requirements.statement: Payment must be taken through the existing external payment provider when the order is placed.
acceptance_criteria: An order is PAID only after the payment provider confirms the payment

requirements.title: No card data
requirements.statement: The platform must not store card numbers.
acceptance_criteria: A scan of all EAEH-managed data stores finds 0 card numbers

requirements.title: Order placement latency
requirements.statement: Order placement must complete within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile.
acceptance_criteria: p95 placement latency <= 2000 ms at 20 orders per second

requirements.title: Availability
requirements.statement: The ordering service must be available 99.9% of each calendar month.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly availability measured by synthetic checks is at least 99.9%

business_rules.statement: An order must contain at least one line.
Each order line has a product and a positive quantity.
An order can be cancelled only until it has been shipped.

domain_concepts.name: Customer
domain_concepts.definition: A registered person who buys products online.

domain_concepts.name: Order
domain_concepts.definition: A customer's request to buy one or more products.

domain_concepts.name: Order line
domain_concepts.definition: A product and quantity within an order.

issues.description: The BRD leaves cancellation of partially shipped orders undefined (TBD).
issues.question: Can the unshipped lines of a partially shipped order be cancelled?

issues.description: The BRD only says order placement must be 'fast'; 2 s at p95 is a proposed target.
issues.question: Is 2 seconds at the 95th percentile acceptable?

out_of_scope.reason: Returns and refunds remain with the existing customer-service process
